unit: a lot footprint the pattern reader read (its least confident read when several sheets read it; condo lots stacked on one parcel shape on one sheet are one case, all their blklots in `blklots`), outlined

design.order: the answered cases first (`front`, in their order), then rounds over the blocks: round k holds each block's k-th least confident footprint (a block's answered cases count as its first rounds), each round by the read's confidence (the pattern reader's own), lowest first; ties by blklot; a footprint by its least confident lot
